note: G3 extends G2's synthetic-proxy corpus (regenerated unchanged, see g2_samples/metadata.json) with real, public-domain images bundled with scikit-image, plus additional tampering edge cases (multi-region copy-move, weak/tiny copy-move, tiny and large images). This remains a small evaluation corpus, not a representative real-world sample -- see the G3 report's Limitations section for an explicit adequacy statement.
